thread:
tina_sales: Hey team — AcmeCorp asking for a 99.99% SLA on generation latency (p95 <= 50ms) for their POC. They claim it's required for their product demo next month. Can we confirm feasibility and what exceptions we need on the MSA/DPA?

alex_legal: 50ms p95 is a hard ask. We need to scope penalties and carveouts. Is this for all models and regions? Also need to know what data residency they require.

mike_infra: @tina_sales quick Q — is this for our Hosted API or Dedicated? 50ms p95 is only realistic on Dedicated with pinned GPUs + model quantization and sequence limits.

luis_se: They sent a perf target doc. Looks like 1 request every 200ms (5 qps) with seq len 64 for UI flows, but also a background bulk rerank at 200 qps with seq 512 — both in the same contract.

sam_research: If the workload is mostly seq<=64, we can hit ~40ms p95 on some small Llama variants on Dedicated with batching tuned. 200 qps @512 is the problematic piece — that changes everything.

alex_legal: From contract side, we need a performance appendix: list of test vectors, allowed model variants, regions, and explicit fallback policies. Also need an SLA exception clause if they want Guaranteed 50ms for all workloads.

mike_infra: Proposal: offer two-tier SLA. Hosted: 99.9% with standard latency profile. Dedicated (reserved): custom SLA with performance appendix + runbook and a capped credit. We'll require their test harness and a pre-prod load window.

luis_se: Action items for engineering: 1) get their representative sample prompts & seq distribution, 2) run our synthetic runner with both tokenization and batching match. Example command we use:```bash
rundriver --target-host=dedicated.redwood.example --qps=200 --seq=512 --duration=600
```
Share results and we'll mark which model/value-tier meets 50ms p95.

tina_sales: Customer says they want Hosted for speed of onboarding. They're open to Dedicated if we can show numbers and pricing delta. Also legal wants to see a draft performance appendix to iterate.

alex_legal: I'll draft a performance appendix that includes: test vectors, measurement methodology (p95 over 10m windows), permitted maintenance windows, and explicit fallback (auto-degrade to larger latency model) + credit cap (e.g., monthly cap at 5% of fees). Any objections?

sam_research: Works for me. Add explicit exclusion for model upgrades and regional outages, and require 48h notice for planned infra maintenance in the appendix.

mike_infra: Logistics: we need a 72h pre-provision window for Dedicated. Also request they sign an order form for reserved capacity before we commit to the custom SLA. Pricing estimate: ~2.5x hosted rate for the SLA/priority lane.

tina_sales: I'll relay — can you draft the order form language for reserved capacity + signatures routing? They use DocuSign but ask for a SCIM SSO link for provisioning after signature.

alex_legal: I'll put together MSA addendum language and the performance appendix draft. ping @luis_se and @mike_infra for the technical bits I can't authoritatively declare.

luis_se: I'll prepare perf-run checklist and a list of model variants we'll benchmark. Expect initial numbers in ~48 hours.

deploy-bot: perf-harness: run queued: 1769995012-acme-sla-run-1 started by luis_se (ETA 45m).

tina_sales: Thanks all. I'll hold off on committed PO until we have numbers and a short pricing note. Customer happy with draft order form flow. :+1:

alex_legal: Once we have numbers, I'll add the SLA thresholds to the appendix and route the MSA/DPA for signatures. Recommend 2 countersigners: sales ops and legal.

mike_infra: FYI — if we can't meet 50ms for the high-seq rerank, propose offering a hybrid: 50ms p95 for UI model (seq<=64) + best-effort for rerank with explicit latency targets (p95 <= 250ms). That tends to be acceptable to customers.

tina_sales: Noted. I'll propose the hybrid and share back their preference. Closing loop after luis posts perf results.
